name: Rock Howard
source:
A recent transfer student to the protagonist's high school.
He quickly became a hot topic with the female students.
He's rather shy though and doesn't feel comfortable being in the spotlight.
He joined the basketball club but doesn't have any close friends. He only trusts Terry.
He has a secret fan club of female students that call him 'Prince'.
